_comment: Condex MCP — Example configurations for all search modes. Copy the relevant block into your MCP client config (Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, etc.).

condex-bm25._description: BM25 mode (default) — keyword/identifier search, fastest, ~91.8% token savings, no model download needed

condex-vector._description: Vector mode — semantic/natural-language search, ~47.3% token savings. Pre-download model with 'npm run download-model' to avoid ~100MB download on first startup.
condex-vector._note_CONDEX_MODEL_CACHE_DIR: Optional. Leave empty for default (~/.cache/condex/models on Linux, ~/Library/Caches/condex/models on macOS). Set to override model cache location.

condex-hybrid._description: Hybrid mode — BM25 + Vector with RRF fusion, best recall, ~47.3% token savings. Pre-download model with 'npm run download-model' to avoid ~100MB download on first startup.

condex-smart._description: Smart mode — BM25 first with stricter threshold, falls back to vector when confidence is low, ~82.1% token savings, best balance. Pre-download model with 'npm run download-model' to avoid ~100MB download on first startup.

_claude_code_example._description: For Claude Code: add to ~/.claude.json under projects.<path>.mcpServers

_opencode_example._description: For OpenCode: add to opencode.json in project root under mcp

_cursor_example._description: For Cursor: add to .cursor/mcp.json in project root

_all_env_vars._description: Complete list of environment variables with defaults
_all_env_vars.CONDEX_MODEL_CACHE_DIR: Override embedding model cache directory (default: ~/.cache/condex/models on Linux, ~/Library/Caches/condex/models on macOS)
_all_env_vars.CONDEX_SMART_BM25_MIN_SCORE: Stricter BM25 threshold for smart mode (default: 0.5)
_all_env_vars.CONDEX_SMART_VECTOR_MAX_DISTANCE: Vector distance threshold for smart fallback (default: 0.90)
